sub_answers.text: Kathleen 'Kitty' Buckley won Ashbourne Cup medals with University College Cork in 1936 and 1937 [d28262014s1p0]. She subsequently played for Cork, winning five All-Ireland senior medals and scoring prolifically for both club and county, including goals in multiple All-Ireland finals [d28262014s0p0][d28262014s1p0].
